provenance.method: Sanitized transcription of the selected summary and exact document-only screenshot crop; no new native run.
provenance.limits: Raw receipts, installed files, private catalog and unrelated external material were not inspected. A configured source SHA is not independently measured installed bytes.
provenance.historicalEvidence: Unchanged; earlier gaps are newly observed only on this configured source and app scope, not rewritten as universal guarantees.

claims.eventMeaning: Subscription-only evidence; actual typed event, subagent identity and timestamp qualification remains unproved.
claims.scopeLimit: One observed native local-catalog installation on this source/app; not a universal catalog syntax or supported-platform guarantee.

cleanup.disableAttempt: UI Automation Toggle returned Unrecognized error
cleanup.subsequentObservation: After list refresh the QA entry was absent; an unrelated source update error was displayed.
cleanup.meaning: Final cleanup of observed QA additions passed; this does not establish independent disable or uninstall control passes.

newCandidate.evidenceRevisionPolicy: This evidence-only follow-up leaves artifact bytes unchanged. Derive the enclosing evidence revision from Git history, not a self-referential SHA stored in this document.
newCandidate.upstreamAttribution: Already-merged #177 is integrated, not implemented by this evidence change.
newCandidate.lfContract: Exact-path LF attributes preserve canonical candidate bytes under core.autocrlf=true and false; both isolated checkout modes matched canonical blobs.
newCandidate.artifactMeaning: Expected canonical candidate bytes below are not installed-provider observations or baked commit proof. New diagnostics hash bounded actual own files on disk at observation time; that native observation has not run on this candidate.

reportedLocalChecks.source: Sequential implementation editor's integrated-candidate report; not rerun by this evidence editor

evidenceEditorChecks.scope: Actual inventory after adding these evidence files; existing dist assets only, not a release build or proof dist matches the new candidate.

remaining: Independent installed-artifact source digests, including native qualification of the new candidate diagnostics
Clean separate native disable and uninstall controls
Update and rollback between distinct approved versions
Session resume/replacement, app exit and abrupt process loss
Actual typed events, subagent identity and timestamps
Explicit production scope and minimum supported platform/version decisions

image.method: Lossless document-only crop of the actual selected PNG; application chrome excluded, no replacement pixels or synthetic render.
image.pixelEquality: PASS: decoded RGB bytes exactly equal the same source rectangle after save/reopen
image.privacyReview: Retained pixels contain generic synthetic read-only documentation only.
image.scope: Visible document render only; screenshot does not independently prove summary lifecycle claims.
